Eight tall straight swords planted in the ground around her leaving an open front gap
Shallow rippled water pooling across muddy flats around her feet
Distant stone castle perched atop a high rocky cliff in the background
Pale overcast sky beginning to clear beyond the surrounding blades
zh: 蒙着双眼、身缠松散布带却双脚自由站立的女子
在身周插成半环、唯独正前方留出空隙的八柄笔直长剑
漫过脚畔湿地的浅浅水洼，象征游移不定的情绪
远方峭壁之巅巍然矗立的石砌城堡
剑阵之外正透出微明清光的灰白天空

en: Graceful Belle Epoque woman in a crimson-slate and ivory silk gown standing in shallow silver ripples, eyes covered by a pale silk blindfold and torso wrapped in visibly slack silver-gold ribbons while her feet remain completely free
Eight tall gleaming frost-silver and antique-gold swords planted vertically point-down in two symmetrical clusters—four on the left and four on the right—leaving the forward water clearly open
Shallow moonlit cyan-silver tidal flats reflecting the standing blades and pale silk folds
Distant moonlit stone citadel rising cleanly atop a misty indigo cliff behind her
High-contrast moonlight separating every single one of the eight vertical blades from velvety twilight storm clouds
zh: 立于银色浅水之中、身着暗红灰蓝丝裙、蒙着素白眼罩且身上金银丝带明显松弛、双脚完全自由的美好年代女子
左右各四柄、对称插立成半环且正前方留出宽敞空路的八柄霜银古金长剑
映出剑影与衣褶微光的月青色浅滩涟漪
远方靛蓝悬崖之上清晰勾勒的月光石堡
清亮月色将八柄笔直立剑逐一从深沉暮云中锐利分离

core.en: Eight of Swords captures the claustrophobia of feeling trapped by rules, fears, or worst-case narratives—yet the bindings are slack and the ground in front of your feet is open. Your agency is far larger than your current story admits.
core.zh: 宝剑八刻画了被规则、顾虑或最坏念头困在原地的窒息感——但仔细一看，束缚本就松散，脚下前路也并没封死。你实际拥有的主动权，远比脑中故事承认的更大。

message.en: Test the constraint you think is unbreakable—at least half of what feels off-limits right now is an outdated assumption.
message.zh: 去碰一碰那个你以为铁板一块的限制——眼下让你动弹不得的条框，至少有一半只是过时的假设。

foundation.en: Past criticism, fear of getting burned again, or rigid expectations taught you to shrink your options before anyone else did.
foundation.zh: 过往的苛责、怕重蹈覆辙的阴影或刻板要求，让你在外界真正阻拦之前就先替自己缩窄了选择。

present.en: You feel hemmed in on all sides, yet the real bottleneck is tunnel vision—looking only at risks makes every step feel impossible.
present.zh: 你正觉得四面受掣，但真正的卡点其实是视野收窄——眼里只盯着风险时，迈出半步都会显得寸步难行。

challenge.en: Waiting to be rescued or rehearsing every reason you 'cannot' move keeps loose ribbons acting like steel chains.
challenge.zh: 坐等外力解围，或在脑中反复罗列“我为什么动不了”的理由，会让原本松散的丝带活生生发挥出铁链的效力。

resource.en: Your feet are already free—one grounded reality check or outside perspective can show you the gap between the blades immediately.
resource.zh: 你的双脚其实一直自由——一次平实的现实核验或旁观者的清醒视角，就能立刻指给你剑阵正面的缺口。

action.en: Pick one 'I have no choice' belief and challenge it with a tiny concrete test today—ask the question, send the inquiry, or step two feet forward.
action.zh: 挑出一条“我别无选择”的念头，今天就用一个小动作去打破它——直接发问、打听新路或向前踏出切实一步。

outcome.en: Stagnation persists only while the blindfold stays on; the moment you check actual facts instead of fear, breathing room opens fast.
outcome.zh: 困局只会在蒙眼猜测时持续；一旦用真实核查替换脑内恐吓，回旋空间很快就会打开。

advice.en: Stop arguing for your own limitations—look down at your feet and take the small step already available.
advice.zh: 别再替自己的限制做辩护了——低头看清脚下，先把眼前已经够得着的那一小步走出去。

hidden.en: Examine the rule you believe you cannot break. It may never have been stated by anyone and may rest on a fear you have not tested, with more room around it than you have looked for.
hidden.zh: 细看那条你认定不能破的规矩。它也许从没有谁明说过，只是建立在一份没检验过的恐惧上；它周围的余地，可能比你找过的要大。

self.en: You see yourself as having no options, and you present yourself that way to others. You bring caution and a careful sense of risk, but for now they are pointed at reasons to stay where you are.
self.zh: 你认定自己没有选择，在别人面前也是这副样子。你带来的是谨慎和对风险的细致掂量，只是眼下它们全被用来找留在原地的理由。

other.en: The other person appears to feel cornered and may insist that their hands are tied. They are likely waiting for someone else to make the first move, and they may not see choices that look obvious to you.
other.zh: 对方看起来觉得自己被逼到了墙角，可能一再强调自己身不由己。他们多半在等别人先动，那些在你看来明摆着的选择，他们也许并没有看见。

external.en: Real constraints exist around you: rules, expectations, limited means, other people's opinions. They are looser than they appear, but the atmosphere is restrictive and nobody nearby is pointing out the exit.
external.zh: 你周围确实有限制：规章、别人的期待、有限的条件、旁人的看法。它们没有看上去那么紧，但气氛压抑，身边也没人给你指出口在哪里。

hopes_fears.en: The hope is that someone will come and free you; the fear is what you would have to do if you found you could leave unaided. Staying stuck is miserable, and it also spares you a frightening choice.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼的是有人来替你解开束缚，怕的是发现自己其实能走之后，就得独自去做那些事。困在原地很难受，却也替你免掉了一个吓人的选择。

general.en: You have more room to maneuver than anxious thinking admits. Question inherited rules, lift the blindfold, and walk through the open front gap.
general.zh: 你手里的腾挪空间远大于焦虑所描绘的模样。质疑未经检验的条框，摘下眼罩，顺着正前方的空隙走出去。

love.en: In love, Eight of Swords reflects feeling silenced, walking on eggshells, or staying in a cramped pattern out of fear of being alone. Honest voice breaks the spell.
love.zh: 在感情里，宝剑八常表现为如履薄冰、有话不敢直说，或因害怕孤单而把自己缩在逼仄模式里。真实说出感受，困局便会松动。

career.en: At work, imposter syndrome, golden handcuffs, or rigid internal scripts are shrinking your perceived options. Talk to peers outside your bubble to test what is actually possible.
career.zh: 在工作上，自我怀疑、路径依赖或既定条条框框正在压缩你眼中的出路。主动和圈外同行聊一聊，核实外面究竟有哪些真实选择。

health.en: Stress and anxious rumination can make minor setbacks feel inescapable; ground yourself in one simple physical action—breath, a walk, or calling a trusted support.
health.zh: 焦虑反刍容易把小困扰放大成无解困局；先回到一件触手可及的身体动作——深呼吸、出门走一段或联系信赖的人——迅速松开窒息感。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, notice how fiercely the mind defends a familiar cage; freedom starts the second you recognize a thought as a thought, not a wall.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，看清头脑有多习惯守着熟悉的笼子；当你认出一个念头只是念头而非铁墙的那一秒，自由就已经开始了。

core.en: Eight of Swords reversed signals the moment the ribbons loosen and sight returns: you see through an old limiting story and reclaim your right to choose—or wrestle with self-blame on the way out.
core.zh: 宝剑八逆位标志着松绑与重见天光：你看穿了一直困住自己的旧剧本、重新拿回选择权，或在脱身前与自我苛责做最后拉锯。

blocked.en: Seeing the exit clearly yet still hesitating to step out because old fear feels familiar.
blocked.zh: 明明已经看见出口，却因为习惯了旧顾虑而迟迟不肯迈脚。

excess.en: Turning harsh self-criticism inward—blaming yourself mercilessly for ever feeling stuck.
excess.zh: 把所有锋芒对准自己——苛刻责怪自己当初为何那么久没走出来。

internalized.en: Quietly dismantling an old fear in private before making your visible move.
internalized.zh: 正在内心悄悄拆掉旧日枷锁，为接下来的明面行动蓄势。

release.en: Slipping the blindfold off and walking cleanly past the blades with renewed agency.
release.zh: 利落摘下眼罩，带着重新握紧的主动权走出剑阵。

message.en: What held you was a story about what you could not do, and it has stopped being convincing. You have more say here than you have been using.
message.zh: 困住你的是一套“我做不到”的说法，而它已经不再令人信服。在这件事上，你手里的主动权比你一直动用的要多。

foundation.en: For a long time you believed you had no choice, and you arranged your life around that belief. Recently something cracked it: a fact, a conversation, or simply reaching the end of your patience.
foundation.zh: 很长一段时间里，你相信自己别无选择，日子也是照着这个信念过的。最近有什么让它裂开了：一个事实，一次谈话，或只是耐心终于用到了头。

present.en: The bindings are loosening. You can see options that were invisible before and you are beginning to move, though some stiffness and self-reproach remain from the time spent standing still.
present.zh: 束缚正在松开。先前看不见的选项现在看得见了，你也开始动起来，只是站了那么久之后，身上还留着些僵硬和自责。

challenge.en: Self-blame or lingering hesitation at the doorway is slowing a liberation that is already within reach.
challenge.zh: 自我责怪或站在门口的最后犹豫，正在拖慢一场明明已经触手可及的松绑。

resource.en: You now know how the trap worked, and that knowledge stays with you. Having talked yourself out of one false limit, you can recognize the next one sooner and help others notice theirs.
resource.zh: 你现在知道这个困局是怎么运作的了，这份认识会一直留在你身上。既然已经把自己从一道假限制里劝了出来，下一道你会认得更快，也能帮别人看见他们的。

action.en: Act on the clear perspective you just gained—make the call, decline the unfair constraint, and step into open ground.
action.zh: 趁这份难得的清醒立刻落到行动上——拨出那通电话、拒绝不合理的束缚，直接走上开阔地。

outcome.en: Real relief and regained autonomy are likely to unfold from here; options tend to multiply once you stop filtering everything through fear.
outcome.zh: 切实的松弛感与自主权很可能由此回归；一旦不再透过恐惧的滤镜看一切，可行的路往往会越来越多。

advice.en: Do not scold yourself for how long you wore the blindfold—just enjoy seeing clearly and keep walking.
advice.zh: 别回头数落自己戴了多久眼罩——珍惜此刻清明的视野，稳步往前走就好。

hidden.en: Check whether a part of you still prefers the old restriction. Freedom brings responsibility, and an unadmitted wish to stay excused may be behind the hesitation at the exit.
hidden.zh: 查一查是否有一部分的你仍然更愿意待在旧限制里。自由连着责任，出口前的那点迟疑，背后也许是一个没承认的愿望：继续不必负责。

self.en: You are coming out of a long period of feeling powerless. You show up more willing to speak and choose for yourself, but still inclined to blame yourself for not having done so earlier.
self.zh: 你正在走出一段很长的无力期。现在的你更愿意开口、更愿意自己做主，却仍然忍不住责怪自己为什么没有早点这样做。

other.en: They may be starting to act for themselves after a long passive spell. They appear less willing to accept old terms, and they may be unsteady or defensive while they find their footing.
other.zh: 对方可能在长期被动之后，开始为自己拿主意。他们看起来不大愿意再接受旧条件；在站稳脚跟之前，也可能显得不太稳当或带着防备。

external.en: Restrictions around you are easing. A rule has changed, someone's hold has weakened, or an option has opened that did not exist before, and the surroundings are less confining than they were.
external.zh: 你周围的限制正在放松。一条规则改了，某个人的掌控弱了，或出现了一个之前没有的选项，周遭不再像从前那样把人圈得那么紧。

hopes_fears.en: You hope the freedom you glimpse is real, yet fear you will not know what to do with it. You are relieved to see an exit and anxious about being answerable for where you go next.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着眼前瞥见的自由是真的，又怕到手之后不知该拿它怎么办。看见出口让你松了口气，可接下来往哪走都得自己负责，这又让你不安。

general.en: Mental barriers are dissolving. Trust your fresh perspective, release self-imposed guilt, and exercise the freedom now in front of you.
general.zh: 心里那堵看不见的墙正在瓦解。相信你新获得的清醒视角，放下无谓自责，坦然用起眼前的自由。

love.en: In love, reversed Eight of Swords brings candid self-advocacy—dropping fear-based compliance and speaking plainly about what healthy partnership looks like.
love.zh: 在感情中，宝剑八逆位带来清醒的自我表达——不再因为害怕失去而委屈迎合，坦然说出健康关系应有的模样。

career.en: At work, you spot the exit out of a dead-end routine or outgrow self-doubt that kept you from negotiating or pitching boldly.
career.zh: 在职场上，你终于看清跳出停滞循环的出口，或摆脱了长期拦着你大胆谈判与争取机会的自我设限。

health.en: Anxiety loosens its grip as you replace helplessness with small, manageable habits that remind you of your own steadiness.
health.zh: 焦虑的紧箍正慢慢松开；用几项小而可控的日常习惯替代无力感，会让你重新摸到踏实掌控感。

spirituality.en: Liberation here feels grounded and ordinary: dropping an old fear script and meeting reality with open eyes.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，真正的解脱未必惊天动地，往往就落在你亲手丢掉旧恐惧剧本、平静睁开双眼平视真实当下的这一刻。

archetypeEssence.zh: 凌晨三点独坐难眠的思绪漩涡——夜色把悬而未决的担忧放大到远超白日的真实比例。

Carved wooden bed panel showing two figures in tense struggle

Cool silver moonlight streaming obliquely from an unseen window to illuminate the hands, nightgown folds, embroidered quilt, and every horizontal blade

绣有月白玫瑰、古金星辰方格与风暴灰菱纹的新艺术拼花织被

core.en: Nine of Swords speaks honestly to acute worry, guilt, and late-night catastrophizing. Notice the decisive visual cue: every blade hangs on the wall of thought rather than touching your skin—fear is peaking in the dark, not predicting doom.
core.zh: 宝剑九如实映照深重焦虑、内疚反刍与深夜灾难化想象。留意牌面最关键的真相：九柄剑全都悬在思绪墙上，并没真正刺中你——此刻到达顶峰的是暗夜里的恐惧，而不是厄运的预告。

message.en: Do not trust conclusions written at 3 a.m.—bring the fear out of solitary silence into daylight and factual checking.
message.zh: 别相信凌晨三点脑中写出的判决书——把那份担忧带出孤立夜色，放到白日与客观核对下再看。

foundation.en: Accumulated stress, an unspoken regret, or prolonged uncertainty wore down your calm until worry took over the room.
foundation.zh: 日积月累的压力、未说出口的愧疚或悬而未决的煎熬慢慢磨薄了防线，让焦虑占了上风。

present.en: Your mind is running worst-case rehearsals on repeat, making an already tough issue feel twice as heavy as its actual facts.
present.zh: 你的大脑正循环播放最坏剧本，让本来就棘手的问题在体感上平白翻倍。

challenge.en: Isolating with anxious thoughts turns manageable problems into monsters; keeping everything locked in your own head magnifies distress.
challenge.zh: 把焦虑锁在自己脑子里独自消化，会把原本可解的问题喂成巨兽；越沉默硬扛，煎熬越会被放大。

resource.en: Your sensitivity flags what genuinely matters to you—once separated from panic, it points directly to the one concrete thing worth tending.
resource.zh: 这份敏锐其实标出了你真正珍视的东西——只要把惊慌剥离，它便能直指那件最值得着手处理的实事。

action.en: Write the three loudest fears on paper, mark which parts are verified fact versus prediction, and share one of them aloud with a grounded ally today.
action.zh: 把最吵闹的三条担忧写到纸上，标清哪些是已发生事实、哪些只是猜测，今天选其中一条向稳重可信的人说出口。

outcome.en: Mental strain hits its crest and begins to break once brought into honest light; relief starts the moment secrecy and isolation end.
outcome.zh: 精神紧绷在触顶后将随摊开直视而松动；只要结束独自硬熬，轻省便会从那一刻开始回流。

advice.en: Treat yourself with daylight kindness—rest your mind first, and refuse to negotiate with catastrophic thoughts in the dark.
advice.zh: 用白天的温和对待自己——先稳住身心休息，拒绝在夜色里和灾难化念头讨价还价。

hidden.en: Consider what you are not saying aloud. A regret or a worry you have told nobody about may be driving the sleepless nights, and it is likely smaller in fact than it has grown in private.
hidden.zh: 想一想你没有说出口的是什么。一份没对任何人讲过的懊悔或担忧，也许正是那些不眠之夜的源头；它实际的分量，多半比独自捂着时膨胀出来的小。

self.en: You come to this anxious and hard on yourself, convinced the worst is likely and that much of it is your fault. You care a great deal, and at the moment that care has turned into self-accusation.
self.zh: 你带着焦虑来到这里，对自己很苛刻，认定最坏的情况很可能发生，而且多半怪自己。你是真的在乎，只是这份在乎眼下变成了自我指责。

other.en: The other person may be carrying a heavy worry they have not shared. They appear tense, tired, or preoccupied, and what looks like coldness toward you is likely to be strain.
other.zh: 对方可能背着一份没说出口的沉重心事。他们显得紧绷、疲惫或心不在焉，那些看似冲着你的冷淡，多半只是压力所致。

external.en: The surroundings feed worry: unanswered questions, bad news in circulation, long waits for results, pressure with no clear end. Much of this is outside your control, which is part of why it keeps you awake.
external.zh: 周围的环境在给焦虑添柴：没有答复的问题，四处流传的坏消息，迟迟不来的结果，看不到头的压力。其中大半不由你掌控，这也是它让你睡不着的原因之一。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to be told that your fears are unfounded, yet fear they are accurate. You long for one night of unbroken sleep and dread what morning might confirm.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着有人告诉你这些担心都是多余的，又怕它们其实说中了。你渴望睡一个完整的觉，却害怕天亮之后会证实些什么。

general.en: Worry and mental exhaustion are amplifying real stress into nightmare proportions. Ground yourself in verified facts and trusted conversation.
general.zh: 过度思虑与精神倦怠正把现实压力放大成噩梦比例。回到可核对的事实与可信赖的交流中，先稳住重心。

love.en: In love, Nine of Swords reflects agonizing over unspoken doubts, fear of abandonment, or replaying a painful mistake alone. Calmly voicing the worry beats silently suffering it.
love.zh: 在感情里，宝剑九反映独自揣测未说破的怀疑、害怕失去，或反复为旧失误自责。平静把担忧讲出来，远胜过独自在夜里反复煎熬。

career.en: At work, high-stakes pressure, imposter anxiety, or dreading a single error is stealing sleep. Break the looming dread into one concrete checklist and ask for backup where needed.
career.zh: 在职场上，高压截止日、担心出错或过度自我审视正在偷走你的睡眠。把庞大的恐惧拆成一张具体清单，需要协同处大方开口。

health.en: Disrupted sleep, racing thoughts, and nervous tension deserve genuine care—protect evening wind-down and reach out to trusted people or qualified support rather than white-knuckling alone.
health.zh: 睡眠变浅、思绪停不下来与神经紧绷值得认真对待——守好睡前缓冲，必要时主动向亲友或专业人士求助，别一个人咬牙死撑。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, dark nights of worry reveal where you are demanding total certainty from an uncertain world; compassion quiets what perfectionism inflames.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，焦虑难眠的暗夜照出你对绝对掌控的执念；完美主义越煽风点火，温和慈悲越能替你止息风暴。

core.en: Nine of Swords reversed signals the nightmare loosening its grip as morning perspective returns—or warns that hidden panic and shame are being swept under the rug instead of healed.
core.zh: 宝剑九逆位提示噩梦开始松动、白日视角回归，也提醒留意自己是否把深层焦虑与羞愧硬压到台面下假装没事。

blocked.en: Refusing to admit how stressed you are keeps low-grade dread humming beneath a calm exterior.
blocked.zh: 硬撑着不肯承认压力太大，让隐性恐慌在体面外表下持续嗡鸣。

excess.en: Spiraling deeper into private shame or convincing yourself nobody would understand.
excess.zh: 滑向更深的隐秘自责，固执以为没人能理解你的处境。

internalized.en: Quietly realizing that the worst fear you braced for never actually materialized.
internalized.zh: 内心已隐隐察觉，当初最害怕的那场灾难其实并没有真正发生。

release.en: Opening the curtains—speaking the worry aloud shrinks it back to manageable daylight size.
release.zh: 拉开窗帘——把恐惧说出口的那一刻，它便缩回了白天能处理的正常尺寸。

message.en: Look at what actually happened. The disaster you braced for has not arrived, and you are allowed to stop standing guard against it.
message.zh: 看看实际发生了什么。你严阵以待的那场灾难并没有到来，你可以不必再为它站岗了。

foundation.en: A long stretch of worry lies behind this: nights of imagining the worst, much of it kept to yourself. That strain shaped your choices even when the feared events did not occur.
foundation.zh: 这件事的背后是一段漫长的担忧：一夜夜设想最坏的情况，而且大多独自闷着。即便害怕的事没有发生，那份紧绷也左右了你的许多选择。

present.en: The worst of the anxiety is lifting. You are sleeping a little better and seeing the problem nearer its true size, though a low hum of dread may persist if you are still hiding how hard it has been.
present.zh: 最厉害的那阵焦虑正在消退。你睡得好了一点，看问题也更接近它本来的大小；不过，如果你仍在掩饰这段日子有多难，隐隐的不安可能还会持续。

challenge.en: Pride or embarrassment about feeling anxious is keeping you from taking the simple relief or support already close by.
challenge.zh: 碍于面子不好意思承认焦虑，拦住了原本近在咫尺的安慰与实际帮助。

resource.en: You have evidence now: you went through the frightening nights and the worst did not come. That record is something to lean on the next time your mind insists that disaster is close.
resource.zh: 你现在手里有了凭据：那些吓人的夜晚你都熬过来了，最坏的事并没有发生。下次脑子再一口咬定大祸临头时，这份记录可以拿来靠一靠。

action.en: Open the window on one secret worry today—talk it through honestly, fix the small practical piece you can control, and drop the rest.
action.zh: 今天把一件闷在心里的担忧摊开透气——找人平实聊透，处理掉可控的那一小块，其余顺其自然。

outcome.en: If this easing continues, the darkest stretch of rumination is likely to give way to clearer mornings, steadier sleep, and a grounded perspective.
outcome.zh: 若这份松动持续下去，最折磨人的胡思乱想很可能逐步退场，让位于更清爽的清晨、安稳的睡眠与踏实的判断。

advice.en: Let daylight measure the problem—most fears lose half their teeth once spoken plainly.
advice.zh: 把问题交给白天的阳光去丈量——大多数恐惧只要平实说出口，立刻就会失去一半锋芒。

hidden.en: Ask whether you are calmer or only quieter. Shame about having been so anxious may be keeping part of the worry out of sight, where it cannot be eased.
hidden.zh: 问一问你是真的平静了，还是只是不出声了。对“自己竟然这么焦虑”的羞耻，也许正把一部分担忧压在看不见的地方，而在那里它是得不到缓解的。

self.en: You are recovering your sense of proportion. You show up less frightened than before and somewhat embarrassed by how bad it became, and you may be playing that down with other people.
self.zh: 你正在找回分寸感。现在的你没有之前那么害怕，对事情曾经糟到那个地步还有点难为情，在别人面前可能会刻意说得轻描淡写。

other.en: They may be coming out of a difficult period they did not tell you about. They appear lighter and more open, or else they are insisting a little too firmly that everything is fine.
other.zh: 对方可能正从一段没跟你提过的艰难日子里走出来。他们显得轻松了些，也更愿意交流；要不然，就是把“一切都好”说得有点过于用力。

external.en: Pressures that fed the worry are easing. An awaited answer has come, a threat has passed, or support has become available, and the people around you are more willing to talk openly about difficult things.
external.zh: 助长焦虑的那些压力正在减轻。等了很久的答复来了，一个威胁过去了，或者有了可以求助的地方，周围的人也更愿意敞开谈难处。

hopes_fears.en: You want to believe the calm will last, and you fear the dread will return as soon as you relax. You hope to tell someone how bad it was, yet worry about what they will think of you.
hopes_fears.zh: 你想相信这份平静能持续下去，又怕自己一放松，那股恐慌就卷土重来。你盼着能告诉别人那段日子有多糟，却担心他们会怎么看你。

general.en: Perspective is returning after intense mental strain. Drop hidden shame, accept support, and measure what is actually in front of you today.
general.zh: 熬过一段紧绷煎熬后，清醒视角正在回流。放下多余羞耻感、接住善意支持，按眼下真实情况重新衡量局势。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Nine of Swords brings honest disclosure that clears away private dread, restoring warmth after an anxious spiral.
love.zh: 在感情中，宝剑九逆位对应把藏着的不安坦白说出、驱散独自脑补的阴霾，让亲密在坦诚后重新回温。

career.en: At work, the looming crisis proves far more manageable than feared; lean on transparent communication and practical prioritization.
career.zh: 在职场上，此前悬在头顶的危机其实远比想象中可控；靠透明沟通与务实排序就能一步步理顺。

health.en: Sleep and nervous balance begin recovering as you stop battling anxious thoughts alone and rebuild gentle daily rhythms.
health.zh: 当你不再在深夜独自与焦虑角力、愿意寻求支持并逐步恢复温和规律的作息，睡眠质量与情绪稳态就会开始切实回升。

spirituality.en: Self-forgiveness breaks the silent courtroom inside your head; dawn arrives gently once you stop prosecuting yourself.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，自我宽恕终结了脑中无休止的自我审判；当你停止苛责自己，晨光便会温柔照进房间。

promptSpec.suitAccent: crisp frost-silver, storm-slate cyan, moonlit ivory, muted rose-gold quilt embroidery, razor-clean antique gold linework
promptSpec.scene: An intimate, poignant Belle Epoque midnight bedchamber bathed in cool oblique silver moonlight against velvety midnight-indigo shadows. Sitting upright on a carved dark-walnut bed draped in an ornate Art Nouveau patchwork quilt embroidered with pale ivory roses, antique-gold star grids, and storm-slate diamond motifs, ONE sleepless figure in a flowing moonlit-ivory silk nightgown leans slightly forward with both hands gently pressed over their face in quiet distress. Mounted horizontally in crisp, evenly spaced parallel rows spanning left to right across the dark bedroom wall directly above the bed are EXACTLY NINE gleaming straight frost-silver and antique-gold swords—every hilt on the left and every pointed blade tip on the right cleanly separated by dark negative space so all nine blades are effortlessly countable. Soft moonlight catches the ivory nightgown folds, clasped hands, embroidered quilt, and the rhythmic horizontal gleam of all nine swords with zero gore or monsters.

requiredObjects.object: sleepless seated figure with hands over face
horizontal parallel straight silver-gold swords mounted on dark wall

promptSpec.compositionNote: Luminous pale seated figure and patterned quilt anchoring the lower half beneath a razor-clean rhythmic ladder of NINE horizontal gleaming silver swords slicing across the velvety dark upper wall—instantly legible at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: An unmistakable ending at rock bottom—painful finality paired with the first band of dawn on the far horizon.
archetypeEssence.zh: 彻底触底的明确终结——刺痛已达极点，而远方地平线正透出第一道微明。

en: Fallen figure pinned beneath ten swords marking an undeniable conclusion
Dark storm sky parting at the distant horizon into pale golden dawn
Still water beyond the shore reflecting quiet aftermath
zh: 身负十柄长剑伏倒在地的身影，标志无可挽回的落幕
远方黑云撕开一道清亮金光的黎明地平线
岸外归于平静的水面，映出风波之后的沉寂

en: Ten tall gleaming frost-silver swords standing vertically across a dark rocky shore against a breaking dawn horizon
Figure resting peacefully beneath a richly draped crimson-and-antique-gold silk mantle in quiet symbolic closure
Radiant molten-gold sunrise slicing beneath dark storm clouds over calm reflecting water
Nocturnal white lilies blooming gently in the dark foreground, signaling clean release and a new cycle
zh: 十柄笔直矗立在幽暗礁岸之上的雪亮银金长剑，与破晓天际线形成鲜明剪影
身覆深红鎏金丝绸长袍、在沉静象征性终结中彻底放手歇息的人物
深蓝风暴云层下方刺破海面的炽亮金红晨曦，映亮平静水面
前景暗影中悄然绽放的月白百合，象征旧章彻底落幕与新周期开启

core.en: Ten of Swords upright signals a clear, painful ending—not a smooth upward trend. Something has run completely out of road, which finally frees you from pouring energy into a finished chapter.
core.zh: 宝剑十正位意味着一段明确而刺痛的终结，绝不是平稳向好的顺风局。某条路已经彻底走到尽头，这反而让你不必再往已经结束的章节里耗费心血。

message.en: This is over, and no further effort will change that. Accept the ending as a fact, and let it release you from a struggle you no longer have to continue.
message.zh: 这件事已经结束，再多努力也改变不了。把这个结局当作事实接受下来，让它把你从一场不必再打下去的仗里放出来。

foundation.en: Something ended completely before this began: a collapse, a betrayal, a failure that left nothing to salvage. You start from the aftermath of that loss, with no continuation of what came before.
foundation.zh: 在这一切开始之前，有什么已经彻底结束了：一次垮塌，一场背叛，一回没有任何东西可抢救的失败。你是从那次失去的废墟上起步的，之前的那一段没有延续下来。

present.en: You are at the lowest point. The thing you feared has happened, there is nothing left to defend, and the pain is real; so is the fact that it cannot fall any further.
present.zh: 你正处在最低点。害怕的事已经发生，没有什么还需要守了，疼是真的；同样真的是，事情已经不可能再往下掉。

challenge.en: The difficulty is finality. There is nothing here to fix, negotiate, or win back, and the hard part is to stop trying while resisting the urge to tell the story as worse than it already is.
challenge.zh: 难处在于“无可挽回”这四个字。这里没有什么可修、可谈、可赢回来的；难的是停止再试，同时忍住不把事情讲得比实际更惨。

resource.en: With nothing left to lose in this matter, you are free of the dread that it might end. That certainty is usable: you know where you stand, and the energy you spent holding it together is yours again.
resource.zh: 在这件事上已经没什么可失去的了，你也就摆脱了“怕它结束”的那份提心吊胆。这种确定是可以用的：你清楚自己站在哪里，原先用来硬撑的力气也都回到了你手里。

action.en: Stop reviving a dead plan—call time cleanly, grieve what stung, and redirect your energy toward recovery.
action.zh: 停止抢救已经失效的方案——干脆画上句号，允许自己消化痛感，把力气转回休养与重启。

outcome.en: This course tends toward a definitive close or a hard burnout limit; if it comes, accepting that the chapter is over is what lets dawn begin.
outcome.zh: 照此走下去，事情多半会迎来一个干脆的句号，或撞上耗尽之后的硬性极限；若真到那一步，承认这一章已经结束，黎明才有机会开始。

advice.en: Stay down long enough to recover, then look toward the horizon. Do not hurry the grief or make it bigger than it is; face the direction in which the sky is getting lighter.
advice.zh: 先伏着歇到缓过来，再抬头看地平线。悲伤不必催，也不必放大；让自己朝着天色渐亮的那一边就好。

hidden.en: Ask yourself whether you saw this coming. There may have been signs you set aside, and admitting that is useful for knowing what to do differently, though it gives you no reason to punish yourself.
hidden.zh: 问问自己是否早有预感。也许曾有一些迹象被你放到了一边；承认这一点，是为了弄明白下次该怎么做，而不是给自己找一个受罚的理由。

self.en: You are defeated and exhausted here, with nothing left to give. You may see yourself as the victim of a total loss; that is an honest reading of the moment, and it describes this moment only.
self.zh: 在这件事里，你挫败而疲惫，已经再拿不出什么。你可能把自己看成满盘皆输的受害者；对此刻来说这是如实的感受，但它描述的也只是此刻。

other.en: The other person appears to be finished with this, either worn out or having closed the door. They may have nothing more to offer, and their withdrawal is likely to be final for now.
other.zh: 对方看起来已经和这件事了断了，不是精疲力尽，就是关上了门。他们可能再也拿不出什么，这次抽身在目前看来多半是定了的。

external.en: Circumstances have closed this off. A decision was made elsewhere, support was withdrawn, or the situation collapsed under its own weight, and none of that was within your power to prevent.
external.zh: 外部形势已经把这条路封死。决定是在别处做出的，支持被撤走了，或局面自己撑不住垮了下来；这些都不是你当时拦得住的。

hopes_fears.en: Part of you hopes this really is the bottom and that it will soon be over, while another part fears there is one more blow to come. You may even want the ending, because the waiting has been worse.
hopes_fears.zh: 一部分的你盼着这真的就是谷底，一切快点过去；另一部分的你却怕后面还有一击。你甚至可能想要这个结局，因为等待本身更难熬。

general.en: An undeniable conclusion closes the loop. The worst of the uncertainty is over; now recovery and a clean slate can begin.
general.zh: 一个无法回避的终结为旧循环画上句号。最折磨人的悬而未决已经触底，接下来可以安心止损并迎来新起点。

love.en: A painful realization, betrayal, or final closure ends a draining cycle. Give yourself real space to heal rather than bargaining with the past.
love.zh: 一段消耗极深的关系模式或悬念迎来痛彻却彻底的落幕。给自己真实疗伤的空间，不再和过去讨价还价。

career.en: A project, role, or approach has hit a hard dead end or severe burnout. Close it cleanly and take the lessons into a fresh direction.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，某个项目、岗位或原有打法已经走到死胡同或严重透支。利落收尾止损，把沉淀下来的经验带向全新方向。

health.en: Exhaustion has reached its floor; stop pushing and treat deep rest and support as urgent priority.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，精力与情绪消耗已经明显触底；请立刻停止咬牙硬撑，把深度休养、卸载非必要负荷与寻求专业照护放在首位。

spirituality.en: A painful illusion dies completely, leaving quiet space for dawn after the darkest hour.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，一个长期消耗你心神的旧执念或执着故事终于彻底熄灭，在最暗的时刻之后，为你腾出迎接破晓微光的静默空间。

core.en: Ten of Swords reversed marks gradual recovery after hitting bottom—pulling the blades out one by one—or reluctance to accept an ending that already happened.
core.zh: 宝剑十逆位指向触底之后的逐步复原——一根根拔出旧伤，或尚未完全甘心放下早已落幕的旧事。

release.en: The sharpest pain has passed; steady healing and renewed perspective are returning.
release.zh: 最剧烈的痛点已经过去，稳定的复原与新视野正在回流。

blocked.en: Replaying an old wound keeps the ending from actually finishing.
blocked.zh: 反复回放旧伤，让原本该翻篇的事迟迟结束不了。

internalized.en: Quietly gathering strength behind the scenes before stepping back out.
internalized.zh: 在无人看见的地方默默回血，准备重新出发。

excess.en: Catastrophizing a setback as total ruin when you still have room to recover.
excess.zh: 把局部挫折想成彻底毁灭，忽略了眼前依然存在的回旋余地。

message.en: You have already hit bottom, and you are on the way up. Recovery comes gradually, one blade at a time, and it goes faster once you stop going back over how it happened.
message.zh: 你已经触过底，现在是在往上走。复原是一点一点来的，像把剑一柄一柄拔出来；不再反复回想事情是怎么发生的，它会快一些。

foundation.en: You have already been through the collapse. What stands behind this situation is a low point you survived, and you have been rebuilding since then, sometimes without noticing that you were.
foundation.zh: 垮掉的那一段你已经经历过了。这件事的背后是一个你挺过来的低谷，从那以后你一直在重建，有时连自己都没察觉。

present.en: You are getting back up. Strength returns in small amounts, some days better than others, and parts of the old ending still pull at your attention.
present.zh: 你正在重新站起来。力气一点点回来，有的日子好些，有的日子差些，那个旧结局的某些部分仍在牵着你的注意力。

challenge.en: The trouble is an ending that will not stay ended. You keep revisiting it, or you treat a setback as total ruin, and both habits hold you on the ground after the worst has passed.
challenge.zh: 麻烦在于一个结束了却总被翻出来的结局。你不停地回头看它，或把一次挫折当成全盘皆毁；这两种习惯，都让你在最糟的时候过去之后还趴在地上。

resource.en: You have survived something you thought you could not, and that is now part of what you know about yourself. The strength you have been rebuilding in private is real and ready for a first careful use.
resource.zh: 你挺过了一件原以为挺不过去的事，这已经成了你对自己的一部分了解。这段时间你私下攒回来的力气是真的，可以先小心地用上一回。

action.en: Do one small thing today that belongs to your life after this ending: make an appointment, clear away one reminder, or reply to someone you have been avoiding.
action.zh: 今天做一件属于“这件事之后”的小事：约一个时间，收走一样让你触景生情的东西，或回复一个你一直躲着的人。

outcome.en: If you keep letting the old matter rest, strength and perspective are likely to return steadily. If you keep reopening it, recovery tends to stall at the point where the story is retold.
outcome.zh: 如果你继续让旧事安歇，力气和眼界很可能会稳稳地回来。如果你不断把它重新翻开，复原往往就卡在一遍遍重讲那段经历的地方。

advice.en: Treat yourself as someone recovering from an injury: patient, steady, and unwilling to test the wound every hour. Accept that the ending was real, and that it was the ending of one thing only.
advice.zh: 把自己当成一个正在养伤的人来对待：耐心，稳当，不去每隔一小时就碰一下伤口。承认那个结局是真的，也承认它结束的只是一件事。

hidden.en: Check whether you have fully accepted that it is over. A quiet hope of reversing the ending, or a habit of expecting ruin, may be working unseen and slowing your return.
hidden.zh: 查一查你是否真的接受了它已经结束。一份想让结局翻盘的隐秘期待，或一种总往“全完了”去想的习惯，也许正在暗处拖慢你的恢复。

self.en: You are a survivor in this matter, still sore and more capable than you feel. You are regaining strength away from other people's eyes and may underestimate how far you have already come.
self.zh: 在这件事里，你是一个幸存下来的人，身上还疼，但比自己感觉到的更有能力。你在别人看不见的地方慢慢恢复，可能低估了自己已经走了多远。

other.en: They may be recovering from a serious setback of their own and appear cautious and low on energy. They may also be unwilling to let a finished matter go, returning to it in conversation again and again.
other.zh: 对方可能也在从一次重挫中恢复，显得小心翼翼，精力不济。他们也可能不肯放下一件已经了结的事，在谈话里一遍遍绕回去。

external.en: Conditions are slowly improving after a low point. The crisis has passed, help is easier to find, and the pressure has eased, although the surroundings still show signs of what happened.
external.zh: 低谷过后，外部条件正在慢慢好转。危机已经过去，帮助更容易找到，压力也轻了些，只是周遭仍留着那件事的痕迹。

hopes_fears.en: You hope the recovery is real and that you can trust it, yet fear being knocked down again just as you stand up. You want to believe the worst is over and hesitate to say so aloud.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着这次恢复是真的、是靠得住的，又怕刚站起来就再被击倒。你想相信最糟的已经过去，却不太敢把这句话说出口。

general.en: Recovery is underway if you stop rehearsing what went wrong. The worst is behind you.
general.zh: 只要不再反复咀嚼哪里出了错，真正的复原就已经在路上。最艰难、最沉重的谷底已经落在你身后。

love.en: Healing after heartbreak or finally refusing to reopen an old wound; let closure actually stick.
love.zh: 在感情中，你正从情伤与心寒里慢慢缓过神来，或终于下定决心不再反复揭开旧疤；把重心收回当下生活，让翻篇真正落地生效。

career.en: Bouncing back from a tough setback or narrow escape from total burnout; rebuild with firmer boundaries.
career.zh: 在职场上，你正从一次重挫或险些彻底崩盘的透支中重新站起身来；带着这次换来的更清晰边界与判断力，稳步展开下一轮布局。

health.en: Slow, real recuperation is taking hold—pace your return without rushing back to full load.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，切实的恢复与元气回升正在逐步启动——顺着身体的反馈循序渐进地调高节奏，别急着一好转就立刻拉满负荷。

spirituality.en: Dawn is no longer just a thin line; resilience grows from integrating what hurt.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，远方地平线上的黎明不再只是一道遥远细线；当你诚实接纳并整合过往伤痛之后，更沉稳真实的韧性正在内在生长。

promptSpec.suitAccent: crisp frost-silver, storm-slate cyan, moonlit ivory, molten golden dawn horizon, razor-clean antique gold linework
promptSpec.scene: A solemn, dignified Belle Epoque coastal dawn rendered in tasteful, strictly symbolic Art Nouveau chiaroscuro with zero blood, zero wounds, and zero gore. Resting face-down in quiet ceremonial stillness along a dark wet rocky shoreline is ONE cloaked figure draped cleanly in a sculptural deep crimson-plum and midnight-indigo mantle, head turned peacefully toward the horizon with one open hand resting calmly on the stone. Standing tall, straight, and evenly spaced in a single rhythmic vertical row planted neatly along the draped cloak's ridge are EXACTLY TEN gleaming straight frost-silver and antique-gold swords—every ornate hilt and luminous blade crisply separated against the dark storm sky so all ten swords are unmistakably countable. Beyond the shore stretches glassy calm slate-cyan water reflecting a glowing horizontal band of molten antique gold and pale ivory dawn breaking sharply beneath heavy midnight-indigo storm clouds across the distant horizon.

tall upright straight silver-gold swords planted in clean row
golden dawn horizon band over still water

archetypeEssence.en: Restless curiosity and quick wits—testing fresh ideas and scanning the wind before making a move.
archetypeEssence.zh: 机敏好奇的年轻锋芒——迎风察看四方动静，在发问与试探中磨炼清澈眼光。

en: Agile youth standing atop a breezy hilltop gripping one straight sword with both hands
Body angled forward while glancing alertly over one shoulder to scan the surroundings
Billowing silver-gray storm clouds sweeping briskly across an open sky
Flock of dark birds wheeling high in the shifting air currents
Uneven windswept turf and bending foliage under fresh gusts
zh: 立于迎风山坡之上、双手紧握一柄笔直长剑的机敏青年
身姿向前却回眸警觉扫视四周的观察姿态
在开阔天幕间迅速奔涌的银灰风起云层

脚下起伏不平、随疾风摇曳的山坡草木

Exactly one long, gleaming straight frost-silver and antique-gold sword gripped firmly in both hands angled crisply upward across the open sky
Sharp curious gaze glancing back over one shoulder with bright moonlit-ivory highlights sculpting face and wind-tousled hair
Sweeping storm-slate clouds and a small wheeling flock of dark swallows riding the midnight breeze overhead
Bending highland grasses and silver-rimmed stones anchoring the restless foreground
zh: 立于月色风岭之上、身着灰青象牙修身短衣与飞扬银边短披风的敏锐美好年代青年
双手稳稳斜举向开阔夜空的一柄霜银鎏金直剑
回眸轻睨、被月白高光清晰勾勒出眉眼与风中发丝的好奇神情
翻涌而过的风暴灰云与高空乘风盘旋的几只夜燕剪影
随风伏动的高地草叶与微泛银光的山石前景

core.en: Page of Swords brings nimble curiosity, sharp observation, and fresh intellectual nerve: ask the candid question, verify the details firsthand, and stay light on your feet as new information arrives.
core.zh: 宝剑侍从带来灵动的好奇心、敏锐观察与敢于发问的锐气：亲自核实细节、抛出直白问题，在新信息不断涌来时保持脚步轻快。

message.en: Stay curious and check the source—one sharp, unafraid question right now reveals more than guessing from afar.
message.zh: 保持好奇并直接追源头——此刻一句坦率而精准的发问，比隔岸猜半天有用得多。

foundation.en: An inquisitive spark, fresh piece of news, or skeptical second look set this whole inquiry in motion.
foundation.zh: 一个灵光一闪的疑问、刚传来的新风声，或一次不盲从的复核，开启了眼前这件事。

present.en: You are in active discovery mode—gathering clues, learning fast, and keeping your guard up while testing what holds true.
present.zh: 你正处在高频探索期——一边敏捷收集线索、飞快学习，一边留着警惕验证什么站得住脚。

challenge.en: Clever skepticism can pass itself off as depth; watch for the urge to swing a sharp comment before you have heard the whole answer.
challenge.zh: 嘴快的质疑容易被误当成洞见；留意那股冲动——对方话还没讲完，就急着抛出一记犀利反驳。

resource.en: Your agility of mind is your edge: fast research, candid curiosity, and noticing small details others gloss over.
resource.zh: 你最大的优势是脑子转得快——查证迅速、敢于坦率发问，还能留意到别人一带而过的小细节。

action.en: Do your homework today: ask the direct question, compare two independent sources, and draft the fresh idea while energy is crisp.
action.zh: 今天就动手做足功课：问出那个关键问题、交叉比对两个独立信源，趁思路正锐利把新点子落成初稿。

outcome.en: If you keep asking and checking, useful news, a fresh mental breakthrough, or a sharper angle is likely to surface, giving you real clarity for the next bigger step.
outcome.zh: 只要继续追问与查证，一条有用的消息、新的思路突破或更锐利的切入角很可能浮现，让你对下一步更大的动作真正心中有数。

advice.en: Keep your curiosity brave and your tone clean—seek truth to understand, not merely to catch someone out.
advice.zh: 让好奇心保持坦荡、语气保持干净——追问真相是为了真正弄懂，而不是为了抓别人小辫子。

hidden.en: There is probably more to find out. A piece of news may not have reached you yet, or a simple question may never have been asked; check what you have assumed without looking into it yourself.
hidden.zh: 多半还有没查到的东西。也许有一条消息还没传到你这里，或一个简单的问题从没人问过；看看有哪些事，是你没亲自查证就默认了的。

self.en: You approach this alert and full of questions, ready to test what you are told. You are a learner here, quick and a little wary, and you would rather ask an awkward question than accept a vague answer.
self.zh: 你带着警觉和一肚子问题来面对这件事，准备把听到的话都验一验。在这里你是个学习者，反应快，也有几分戒心，宁可问一句让人尴尬的话，也不接受含糊的回答。

other.en: The other person appears curious and watchful, asking many questions and saying little about themselves. They may be testing you or gathering information before committing, and they are likely to notice inconsistencies.
other.zh: 对方显得好奇而留心，问得多，关于自己却说得少。他们可能在试探你，或在表态之前先收集信息，前后不一致的地方多半逃不过他们的眼睛。

external.en: News is moving quickly and the situation is still taking shape. Messages, rumors, and new facts are arriving from several directions, and conditions reward whoever stays informed and checks sources.
external.zh: 消息传得很快，局面还在成形。各种信息、传闻和新事实从好几个方向涌来，这样的环境会回报那些保持消息灵通并肯核对来源的人。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to learn the truth of the matter, yet fear what your questions might uncover. You are eager for news and uneasy that it may not be the news you want.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着弄清这件事的真相，又怕自己的追问会翻出些什么。你急着等消息，却也不安：来的未必是你想听的那一条。

general.en: Fresh curiosity, alert observation, and candid fact-finding guide the day. Stay observant, verify what you hear, and welcome lively mental challenge.
general.zh: 敏锐好奇、警觉观察与亲自查证是当下的主旋律。睁亮眼睛核实听闻，大方迎接充满活力的头脑碰撞。

love.en: In love, Page of Swords brings witty banter, genuine curiosity about how the other person thinks, and a call to ask straight instead of decoding texts from the sidelines.
love.zh: 在感情中，宝剑侍从带来机智有趣的对话与想真正了解对方思维的好奇；有疑问就直接坦白问，别躲在屏幕外反复解读字眼。

career.en: At work, this shines for research, auditing, learning a sharp new tool, drafting proposals, or spotting an overlooked edge case early.
career.zh: 在工作与学业上，它非常适合深度调研、审计排雷、快速掌握新技能、起草新方案，或抢先发现别人忽略的边界隐患。

health.en: For wellbeing, stay curious about what your patterns actually show—track sleep, stress triggers, or energy shifts objectively instead of guessing.
health.zh: 在身心层面，带着冷静好奇观察自己的真实规律——如实记录睡眠、压力源与精力起伏，比凭感觉猜测更管用。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, honest questioning refreshes stale dogma; true inquiry respects mystery without checking its brain at the door.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，坦诚发问能吹散僵化教条；真正的探索既敬畏未知，也从不要求你放弃独立思考。

core.en: Page of Swords reversed warns of sharp talk outrunning substance: rumor, reactive snark, scattered curiosity, or firing off half-checked conclusions.
core.zh: 宝剑侍从逆位提醒嘴快跑在实力前面：轻信传闻、冲动挑刺、注意力四处发散，或把没核实的半成品结论随口抛出去。

blocked.en: Second-guessing your voice or holding back a fair question out of fear of sounding naive.
blocked.zh: 怕问出“外行问题”而憋住原本非常合理的质疑。

excess.en: Gossip, nitpicking, or turning curiosity into defensive surveillance and sharp remarks.
excess.zh: 陷入闲话与吹毛求疵，把好奇心用成了处处挑刺与暗中盯梢。

internalized.en: Over-monitoring every tiny signal in silence while building anxious theories nobody confirmed.
internalized.zh: 独自紧盯每一丝风吹草动，在脑中拼出一堆未经证实的猜想。

release.en: Slowing the tongue, checking facts first, and turning scattered talk into one concrete follow-through.
release.zh: 收住急着表态的冲动，先核实事实，把零散议论落实成一件真正做完的事。

message.en: Finish one thing. Your credibility here depends less on having the sharpest comment than on following a single idea through to something you can show.
message.zh: 先把一件事做完。在这件事上，你的可信度不取决于谁的评论最犀利，而取决于能否把一个想法落实成拿得出手的东西。

foundation.en: Hasty words set this in motion: a rumor passed on, a sharp comment made too soon, or a conclusion announced before it was checked. Some of what followed was a reaction to that.
foundation.zh: 这件事是由几句说得太急的话引起的：一条被转述的传闻，一句出口太早的尖刻评论，或一个没核实就宣布的结论。后来发生的事，有一部分是对它的反应。

present.en: There is a lot of talk and not much that is established. You are watching closely, picking up fragments, and forming theories, while several things you started remain unfinished.
present.zh: 眼下议论很多，能坐实的却很少。你盯得很紧，捡到一些零碎的线索，在脑子里拼出各种推测，而你开了头的好几件事还没收尾。

challenge.en: Unverified rumors, defensive sarcasm, or jumping between half-baked ideas is eroding credibility.
challenge.zh: 未经核实的小道消息、带刺的反唇相讥，或在半生不熟的想法间来回跳转，正在消耗你的公信力。

resource.en: Your quick mind is still an asset once it is pointed at one thing. The sharp eye that has been collecting gossip can verify facts just as well, and holding back a remark is a skill you can practice today.
resource.zh: 你转得快的脑子只要对准一件事，仍然是一份本钱。那双一直在搜罗闲话的利眼，用来核实事实同样好使；而把一句话忍住不说，是今天就能练的本事。

action.en: Verify before repeating, shorten the hot take, and back one claim with real evidence before speaking again.
action.zh: 未核实的话不传、带火气的点评先按住，拿出一份过硬证据再去支撑你的观点。

outcome.en: Small misunderstandings or wasted detours happen if words fly ahead of preparation; tightening accuracy clears them fast.
outcome.zh: 若话跑在准备前面，容易招来小误会或绕弯路；只要把准确度收紧，风波很快就能平息。

advice.en: Listen twice before swinging once—smart restraint makes your words carry ten times the weight.
advice.zh: 出言之前多听两遍——懂得克制的机敏，才能让你的话真正掷地有声。

hidden.en: Check where your information came from. A story you have accepted may rest on hearsay, and the theory you have built from small signs may never have been confirmed by anyone.
hidden.zh: 查一查你的消息是从哪里来的。一个你已经信了的说法，也许只是建立在传闻上；你从蛛丝马迹里拼出来的那套推测，可能从没得到过任何人的证实。

self.en: You are either quick with a cutting comment or silent with a question you are afraid to ask. Both ways you are more reactive than prepared, and you have read more into small signals than they can support.
self.zh: 你在这里要么张口就是一句带刺的话，要么憋着一个不敢问的问题不出声。无论哪种，你都是反应多过准备，从细微的信号里读出的东西，也超过了它们撑得起的分量。

other.en: They may be speaking carelessly, repeating things they have not checked, or needling for a reaction. They appear defensive and quick to criticize, so treat their claims as unconfirmed until you see evidence.
other.zh: 对方可能说话欠考虑，转述没核实过的事，或故意挑刺想激你反应。他们显得戒备，批评来得又快，所以在看到证据之前，先把他们的说法当作未经证实。

external.en: The atmosphere is full of gossip and half-information. People are commenting faster than they are checking, messages get misread, and plans change at short notice, so little of what you hear is reliable.
external.zh: 周围充斥着闲话和半截子消息。人们评论得比核实得快，信息常被误读，计划说变就变，所以你听到的内容里，靠得住的很少。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to prove that you are sharp and well informed, yet fear being exposed as wrong or unprepared. You want to ask the obvious question and worry that it will make you look foolish.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着证明自己头脑敏锐、消息灵通，又怕被人看出说错了或没准备好。你想问那个明摆着的问题，却担心一开口就显得很傻。

general.en: Filter out gossip, reactive chatter, and scattered distractions. Slow down long enough to check facts and finish what you start.
general.zh: 主动屏蔽零碎流言、意气口水战与四处分心的信息噪音。沉下心来逐条核实事实，先把已经开头的事踏实收尾落地。

love.en: In love, reversed Page of Swords flags sarcastic jabs, snooping, or jumping to conclusions from a brief message. Pause and verify calmly.
love.zh: 在感情中，宝剑侍从逆位警惕阴阳怪气的试探、暗自翻查或仅凭只言片语就乱扣帽子。先停一拍，平心核实。

career.en: At work, watch for all-talk pitches without execution, sloppy data, or workplace rumor mills. Let verified output speak louder than commentary.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕光说不练的空谈、草率疏漏的数据或茶水间传言。用核验过硬的产出说话，胜过滔滔不绝的点评。

health.en: Restless scrolling and hyper-vigilant mental chatter are frazzling your focus; step away from feeds and quiet the sensory static.
health.zh: 停不下来的刷屏与高度警觉的脑内杂音正在耗散精力；暂时离开信息流，给感官清出安静空间。

spirituality.en: Beware mistaking cynicism for discernment; real clarity stays humble enough to admit what it does not yet know.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，切忌把冷嘲热讽或挑刺当成通透；真正成熟的洞察力始终保有坦然承认“我尚未知晓”的谦逊与开放心态。

archetypeEssence.en: Unstoppable intellectual velocity—charging straight through obstacles before hesitation can catch up.
archetypeEssence.zh: 所向披靡的思维加速度——趁犹豫追上之前，直取核心目标一举破局。

Single straight sword raised high and thrust cleanly ahead into the wind
Crimson-plumed helm and billowing scarlet cape streaming horizontally in the charge
Slender trees bending sharply beneath the force of the rushing wind
Racing storm clouds and diving birds matching the knight's relentless speed

高举向前、直劈长风的一柄笔直长剑

Powerful luminous pale-ivory galloping warhorse adorned with antique-gold and slate-blue barding, mane flying cleanly in the gale
Exactly one long, straight, gleaming frost-silver and antique-gold sword raised high and thrust forward in the knight's right gauntlet
Wind-whipped dark highland cypresses bending sharply beneath rushing midnight storm clouds
Electric silver moonlight slicing across armor, white steed, and raised sword blade against deep velvety night

披挂古金与灰蓝马具、鬃毛迎风飞舞的月白骏马
骑士右甲手高举前指、寒光夺目的一柄霜银古金直剑
在奔涌午夜风暴云下随狂风剧烈弯折的高地暗色柏树
凌厉月光划过银甲、白马与高举长剑，在深邃夜幕中拉出极强动势

core.en: Knight of Swords is pure forward thrust: decisive ambition, fearless candor, and the stamina to slice straight through red tape. Brilliant when timing demands speed—provided you still steer around collateral damage.
core.zh: 宝剑骑士是纯粹的破风推力：果决的野心、毫不拐弯的坦率，以及一剑劈开繁文缛节的冲劲。需要抢窗口期时威力惊人，前提是别把沿途该顾及的细节一并撞翻。

message.en: Move fast and speak straight—this moment rewards bold initiative far more than polite circling.
message.zh: 迅速行动、直来直去——此刻奖励的是果断出手，而不是客客气气地兜圈子。

foundation.en: A decisive push, urgent deadline, or fiercely defended conviction accelerated everything to its current pace.
foundation.zh: 先前一次毫不迟疑的发力、紧迫节点或强烈信念，把整件事推上了如今的高速轨道。

present.en: Momentum is surging at full gallop; channel this razor focus onto the single highest-value target before it scatters.
present.zh: 势头正处在全速疾驰状态；把这份凌厉专注对准唯一最有价值的靶心，别让火力分散。

challenge.en: Tunnel vision at high speed is the hazard: interrupted allies or missed fine print can trip an otherwise bold charge.
challenge.zh: 高速带来的视野盲区才是隐患——被打断的协作者或漏看的关键细则，都可能绊倒一场原本漂亮的冲锋。

resource.en: Your greatest asset is fearless execution—you can cut through paralysis and turn a stalled debate into live motion in hours.
resource.zh: 你最强的资本是毫无畏惧的执行力——能一刀斩断无休止扯皮，几小时内把停滞的讨论变成真实进展。

action.en: Seize the window cleanly: make the direct pitch, ship the decisive fix, or confront the core bottleneck head-on without hedging.
action.zh: 果断抓紧窗口期：直接抛出核心提案、上线关键修复，或正面直击最大卡点，不再左右试探。

outcome.en: At this pace, rapid progress and unmistakable movement are likely; things tend toward brisk results and crisp clarity on where everyone stands.
outcome.zh: 照这个速度，局势很可能迅速推进、动静分明；走向多半是利落的成果，以及各方立场的清晰明朗。

advice.en: Keep your courage fierce and your grip on the reins steady—speed wins only when aimed at the right gate.
advice.zh: 保持勇往直前的锐气，同时握稳缰绳方向——速度只有瞄准正确的城门，才能真正赢下战局。

hidden.en: Check what is being passed over at this pace. A detail, an objection, or a person may be getting left behind, and it is worth asking who set the deadline and whether it is as fixed as it sounds.
hidden.zh: 查一查以这样的速度，有什么被略过去了。一个细节、一条反对意见或某个人，也许正被甩在后面；还值得问一问，期限是谁定的，是否真像听上去那样不能动。

self.en: You arrive determined and already in motion, sure of your argument and impatient with delay. You see yourself as the one who gets things done, and you bring courage, directness, and very little hesitation.
self.zh: 你来的时候已经下定决心，而且人已经在路上，对自己的道理很有把握，对拖延毫无耐心。你把自己看作把事办成的那个人，带来的是勇气、直率和极少的犹豫。

other.en: The other party appears to be moving fast and speaking bluntly, pressing for a quick answer. They may arrive with their mind made up, so expect directness and little patience for a slow discussion.
other.zh: 对方看起来行动很快，说话也直，催着要一个尽快的答复。他们来的时候可能已经拿定主意，所以要有准备：话会很直接，也没多少耐心慢慢讨论。

external.en: Events are moving at speed. Deadlines are close, decisions are being made quickly, and the people around you expect fast, direct responses, which leaves little time to deliberate.
external.zh: 事态正在高速推进。期限迫近，决定下得很快，周围的人都等着迅速而直接的回应，留给你斟酌的时间不多。

hopes_fears.en: You want to break through quickly and settle this in one decisive push, and you fear what you might overlook at that pace. You also dread the alternative: slowing down and losing the opening.
hopes_fears.zh: 你想一鼓作气迅速突破，把事情一次定下来，又怕以这样的速度会漏掉什么。你同样害怕另一种情况：慢下来，然后错过这个窗口。

general.en: Decisive momentum cuts straight through inertia. Act boldly and speak clearly, while sparing two seconds to check who is standing in your path.
general.zh: 一股果决凌厉的推进力正在迅速劈开长期停滞。大胆落子、直白表态以抢占节奏，同时留出两秒确认别误伤沿途同路人。

love.en: In love, Knight of Swords brings electric candor, swift pursuit, or an overdue direct talk that clears stagnation—just watch that intensity stays respectful rather than steamrolling.
love.zh: 在感情里，宝剑骑士带来火花四溅的直率、热烈推进或一场打破沉闷的痛快深谈——只需留意把控分寸，别让急切变成逼迫。

career.en: At work, this excels in rapid launches, decisive crisis response, sharp negotiations, and cutting bureaucracy. Pair your velocity with one quick sanity check before hitting send.
career.zh: 在职场上，他极为擅长闪电上线、危机救急、干脆谈判与破除流程内耗。按下发送或拍板前，顺手做一次简短复核即可万无一失。

health.en: High drive and adrenaline feel exhilarating, yet running permanently at sprint pace invites crashes; build crisp recovery breaks between intense pushes.
health.zh: 充沛冲劲与肾上腺素让人酣畅，但长期只按百米冲刺节奏运转极易后劲透支；在高强度推进间隙留出利落的回血段落。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, fierce devotion slices through comfortable apathy—channel that fire toward truth rather than conquering others.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，炽烈而清醒的求真意志能斩破安逸麻木——把这份锋芒用来照亮真理，而非压服他人。

core.en: Knight of Swords reversed flags reckless haste, blunt outbursts, or spinning wheels at high RPM without a map—time to pull back on the reins before speed creates avoidable wreckage.
core.zh: 宝剑骑士逆位警示盲目狂飙、口不择言的冲撞，或没有地图却拉满转速的空耗——是时候勒住缰绳，免得一味求快酿成原本可避开的碰撞。

blocked.en: Impatient frustration building up because an external gate refuses to move at your pace.
blocked.zh: 外界节奏不随你心意，积攒出一肚子急躁与憋闷。

excess.en: Charging headlong into conflict, interrupting everyone, and burning bridges for the thrill of speed.
excess.zh: 不看路况一头撞进冲突、频频打断别人，为了图快烧掉宝贵信任。

internalized.en: Racing mental restlessness that keeps firing off urges without a clear target.
internalized.zh: 内心焦躁奔涌、念头四处乱撞，却始终没瞄准一个真正落点。

release.en: Deliberately easing off the throttle to aim straight instead of merely moving fast.
release.zh: 主动收油门降速，把精力从“拼命跑快”转回“先瞄准方向”。

message.en: Decide where you are going before you go any faster. Speed without a target is only motion, and right now it is costing you more than a short pause would.
message.zh: 先决定要去哪里，再考虑加速。没有目标的速度只是在动而已，眼下它让你付出的，比停一小会儿要多。

foundation.en: A hasty move lies behind this: something said in anger, a decision pushed through without consultation, or a rush that skipped the planning. You are dealing in part with its consequences.
foundation.zh: 这件事的背后是一步走得太急的棋：一句气头上说的话，一个没商量就强推的决定，或一次跳过了筹划的赶工。你现在处理的，有一部分正是它留下的后果。

present.en: You are either charging without a clear direction or straining against a delay you cannot shift. The energy is high and the progress is small, and tempers, yours included, are short.
present.zh: 你要么在没有明确方向的情况下猛冲，要么在跟一个挪不动的延误较劲。劲头很足，进展很小，大家的火气都不小，你自己的也一样。

challenge.en: Haste, impatience, or abrasive bluntness is triggering resistance that slows you down more than careful pacing ever would.
challenge.zh: 急躁、冲动或过于刺耳的直白正在激起反弹，反而比稳扎稳打拖得更慢。

resource.en: The drive is still yours and is worth keeping; it only needs aiming. Each collision so far has shown you where the obstacles are, and you can choose at any moment to ease off and pick a single target.
resource.zh: 这股冲劲仍然是你的，也值得留着，它只是需要瞄准。之前每一次碰撞都让你看清了障碍在哪里，而你随时可以选择松一松，只挑一个目标。

action.en: Hit pause before firing off the sharp reply or half-baked launch—check one critical assumption and hear one dissenting view first.
action.zh: 发那条带火气的回复或推半成品上线前先踩刹车——核实一个关键前提，先听完一句不同意见。

outcome.en: Expect friction, rework, or a sudden jolt unless you trade brute speed for disciplined aim.
outcome.zh: 如果不把蛮力求快换成有章法的瞄准，前方容易遇到摩擦、返工或急刹震荡。

advice.en: Slow down enough to aim—a calm sniper beats a blind cavalry charge every time.
advice.zh: 慢下两拍先看清靶心——冷静精准的一击，永远胜过蒙头乱冲的骑兵。

hidden.en: Look at what the hurry is protecting you from. Constant motion may be keeping an uncomfortable feeling at bay, or the argument you keep starting may be about something other than its stated subject.
hidden.zh: 看看这份匆忙在替你挡着什么。不停地动，也许是为了把一种不舒服的感觉挡在外面；你一再挑起的那场争论，争的也许并不是它表面上的题目。

self.en: You are impatient and on edge, quick to interrupt and slow to listen. You may feel you are the only one treating this as urgent, and that frustration is coming out in your tone.
self.zh: 你带着不耐烦和紧绷来到这里，打断别人很快，听人说话却慢。你可能觉得只有自己把这件事当急事，这份憋屈正从你的语气里漏出来。

other.en: The other person may be acting rashly or speaking more harshly than the situation warrants. They appear impatient and combative, and they are likely to push harder if they are met with the same force.
other.zh: 对方可能行事鲁莽，或话说得比情况需要的更重。他们显得不耐烦、好争，如果你以同样的力道顶回去，他们多半会冲得更猛。

external.en: The environment is rushed and disorganized. Things are being pushed through without a plan, instructions change mid-course, and delays outside your control are frustrating everyone involved.
external.zh: 外部环境仓促而混乱。事情在没有计划的情况下被硬推，指令中途更改，不受你控制的延误让所有相关的人都心烦。

hopes_fears.en: You hope that sheer effort will force this through, yet fear you are heading for a crash. You are also afraid that if you stop, you will lose your nerve or have to feel what the speed has kept away.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着光靠使劲就能把这件事冲过去，又怕自己正朝着一场碰撞开去。你还害怕一旦停下，勇气就会散掉，或不得不去感受那些被速度挡在外面的东西。

general.en: Pull back from impulsive haste and reactive arguments. Precision and timing matter far more right now than raw velocity.
general.zh: 从冲动赶路和意气争辩里收一收脚。眼下真正决定成败的是准度与时机，而不是一味求快。

love.en: In love, reversed Knight of Swords cautions against snapping in frustration, rushing intimacy too hard, or pushing a partner into a corner for an instant answer.
love.zh: 在感情中，宝剑骑士逆位提醒别在焦躁时脱口伤人、别把关系进度推得太急，也别步步紧逼要对方立刻给答复。

career.en: At work, beware rushed deliverables, combative emails, and shipping before checking edge cases. A fifteen-minute review saves days of cleanup.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕仓促交付、火药味十足的沟通以及跳过验收直接上线。花十五分钟复核，能省下后面几天的返工。

health.en: Overclocked nerves, impatience, and rushing through meals or rest take a quick toll; consciously downshift your tempo today.
health.zh: 神经长期超频、凡事火急火燎甚至连吃饭休息都在赶场，极易耗伤状态；今天刻意把生活挡位降下一格。

spirituality.en: Notice where urgency masks anxiety—wisdom never has to shout or sprint to prove it is real.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，觉察那股停不下来的紧迫感背后是否藏着焦虑——真正的智慧从不需要靠疾驰或提高嗓门来证明自己。

archetypeEssence.en: Lucid discernment earned through experience—compassionate truth spoken without sugarcoating.
archetypeEssence.zh: 历经沉淀后的清明裁断——不敷衍、不情绪化，却有分寸的坦诚。

zh: 端坐于雕花石座之上、侧颜沉静锐利的王后

Cool moonlight ivory, storm-slate silver, and razor-clean antique gold linework with nocturnal moths etched into the throne
zh: 端坐于云岚高处雕花石座、侧颜清冷敏锐的王后
右手笔直竖握的一柄铭刻金纹的雪亮银剑
左手舒展微扬，展现冷静透彻的裁断与边界感
月白高光、风暴银灰与利落古金刻线，石座浮雕夜蛾与星云

core.en: Queen of Swords calls for crisp, honest clarity: cut through polite fog, name facts plainly, and enforce fair boundaries without cruelty or guilt.
core.zh: 宝剑王后要求清晰直接的判断：剥离客套与模糊地带，如实说出事实，在不伤人也不委屈自己的前提下立住公平边界。

message.en: Say the true thing cleanly and simply; clarity is kinder right now than cushioning the facts.
message.zh: 把真话简明干脆地说出来；此刻的坦诚清晰，比绕弯子照顾情绪更善意。

foundation.en: A past lesson, loss, or sharp realization taught you to see patterns quickly and never trade truth for flattery.
foundation.zh: 过往的历练或清醒时刻教会了你一眼看穿本质，不再拿事实去换表面迎合。

present.en: You have the intellectual distance to assess this objectively; separate verified facts from anxious stories.
present.zh: 你现在具备客观审视的冷静距离；把已核实的事实与焦虑脑补彻底分开。

challenge.en: Check whether protective detachment or bluntness is making an ally feel interrogated rather than heard.
challenge.zh: 留意一下：为了自保而保持的抽离，或过于锋利的措辞，是否让同路人觉得自己是在受审，而不是被倾听？

resource.en: Your strongest asset is sharp editorial judgment—knowing exactly what to cut, what question to ask, and where to draw the line.
resource.zh: 你最强的资本是精准的删减与判断力——知道该剪掉什么、该问哪句关键问题、边界画在哪里。

action.en: Write down the exact terms, ask the direct clarifying question, and cut one ambiguous obligation cleanly.
action.zh: 把确切条款写明白，直接抛出那个澄清问题，干脆剪掉一件含糊不清的负担。

outcome.en: This tends toward fog lifting into clean air: an honest agreement, firm boundary, or decisive verdict is likely to restore your self-respect and momentum.
outcome.zh: 走向倾向于迷雾散成清朗空气：一份坦诚共识、稳固边界或果断裁决，很可能帮你找回自尊与前进的势头。

advice.en: Be direct without being cold—hold the sword straight so truth clears the path rather than wounds for sport.
advice.zh: 直率而不刻薄——把剑握直是为了劈开迷雾，而不是借锋利泄愤。

hidden.en: Check what has not been said plainly. There may be a fact everyone is politely avoiding, or a boundary you have decided on privately and not yet stated; clarity here depends on naming it.
hidden.zh: 查一查有什么话还没被直接说出来。也许有一个大家都客气地绕开的事实，或一条你私下已经定好却还没讲明的界线；这件事要清楚，就得先把它点出来。

self.en: You come to this clear-eyed and self-possessed, relying on your own judgment. You say what you think, you know where your limits are, and you would rather be respected for honesty than liked for agreeing.
self.zh: 你带着清醒和自持来面对这件事，靠的是自己的判断。你怎么想就怎么说，清楚自己的界线在哪里，宁可因为诚实受人尊重，也不愿靠附和讨人喜欢。

other.en: The other person appears perceptive and direct, and is unlikely to be swayed by charm or vague answers. They may keep some distance and state their terms plainly, and they are likely to respect honesty in return.
other.zh: 对方显得敏锐而直接，不大会被讨好或含糊的回答打动。他们可能保持着一些距离，把条件讲得很明白，也多半会敬重同样坦诚的回应。

external.en: The setting calls for plain dealing. Terms are being examined closely, people expect straight answers, and sentiment counts for little, so a well-reasoned case is likely to be heard fairly.
external.zh: 眼下的环境要求把话摆明了讲。条款被逐条细看，人们期待直截了当的回答，感情牌起不了多大作用，所以一番有理有据的话多半能得到公正对待。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to be told the truth and to be able to tell it, yet fear how much honesty may cost in closeness. You want clear boundaries and worry about ending up alone behind them.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着听到真话，也盼着自己能把真话说出口，又怕坦诚要拿亲近去换。你想要清楚的界线，却担心最后只剩自己一个人站在界线后面。

general.en: Independent judgment and plain speech serve you best. Strip away assumptions, check the evidence directly, and set clean boundaries.
general.zh: 独立判断与直白沟通此刻最有效。剥除想当然的猜测与客套，直接核对可验证的事实，并划出清爽明确的边界。

love.en: In love, Queen of Swords values candid adult conversation over mind-reading. State your needs and deal-breakers calmly; genuine closeness thrives on honesty, not guessing games.
love.zh: 在感情里，宝剑王后看重成年人之间坦诚直白的对话而非互相猜心。平静说出需求与底线，真正长久的亲密建立在诚实之上。

career.en: At work, this is crisp strategy, editing, legal/contractual rigor, and saying no to scope creep. Rely on clear criteria rather than office politics.
career.zh: 在工作上，她代表利落的策略裁剪、条款严谨与对需求蔓延的干脆拒绝。用明确标准说话，而不是卷入职场揣测。

health.en: For wellbeing, look at your habits and symptoms objectively—track real data or seek a second expert opinion instead of brushing issues aside.
health.zh: 在健康与精力管理上，客观记录真实数据或寻求专业第二意见，别靠侥幸把反复出现的问题糊弄过去。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, discernment itself is wisdom: seeing reality clearly without wishful illusions frees energy for what is true.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，清明辨识本身即是智慧：放下自我安慰的幻觉如实观照，才能把力量留给真正重要之事。

core.en: Queen of Swords reversed signals clouded objectivity—either sharp bitterness is turning discernment into cynicism, or old hurt is making it hard to set a clear boundary.
core.zh: 宝剑王后逆位提示清明度受情绪波及——要么尖刻的怨气让洞察变成冷嘲与防备，要么旧伤未愈让你迟迟划不出清晰边界。

blocked.en: Swallowing an important truth to keep false peace, leaving resentment to simmer.
blocked.zh: 为了维持表面和平把真话咽回肚子，反而让积怨暗自发酵。

excess.en: Cutting people off preemptively or using razor sarcasm as armor against vulnerability.
excess.zh: 先发制人地冷处理，或拿尖锐讽刺当盾牌来遮掩脆弱。

internalized.en: Turning that merciless inner critic entirely onto yourself.
internalized.zh: 把毫不留情的严苛审视全都对准了自己。

release.en: Softening defensive armor without giving up hard-won wisdom.
release.zh: 卸下过度戒备的硬壳，同时保住历经世事修来的清醒判断。

message.en: Separate what you know from what you are braced for. Your judgment is sound when it works from the facts, and less so when it works from an old injury.
message.zh: 把你确实知道的，和你只是在提防的，分开来看。你的判断在依据事实时是可靠的，在依据旧伤时就没那么准了。

foundation.en: An earlier hurt taught you to protect yourself, either with a sharp tongue or by saying nothing at all. That defense was reasonable once, and it is now shaping how you read this situation.
foundation.zh: 先前的一次伤害教会了你自我保护，要么靠一张利嘴，要么干脆什么都不说。这层防备当初合情合理，如今却在左右你怎么解读眼前的事。

present.en: Feeling is clouding your view of this at the moment. You may be harsher than the facts justify, or holding back a necessary truth to avoid a scene, and neither is giving you your usual clarity.
present.zh: 此刻你对这件事的看法被情绪蒙住了。你可能比事实所允许的更严厉，也可能为了避免场面难看而压着一句该说的真话；两种做法都没给你平时那份清明。

challenge.en: Unprocessed hurt is coloring your read of someone's motives—either assuming the worst too fast or tolerating blurred lines too long.
challenge.zh: 尚未消化的旧伤正在左右你对他人动机的判断——要么过快往坏处定性，要么对模糊越界忍让太久。

resource.en: The discernment is intact under the armor. You still know how to see a situation accurately, and you can keep everything experience taught you while setting down the bitterness that came with it.
resource.zh: 铠甲底下，你的判断力完好无损。你仍然懂得怎样把一件事看准，也可以留下阅历教给你的一切，同时放下随之而来的那份苦涩。

action.en: Draft the blunt message, let it sit ten minutes, strip out the sting, and send only the clear boundary.
action.zh: 把犀利的话先写下来放十分钟，删掉带刺的情绪词，只发出清晰坚定的边界。

outcome.en: If the edge stays in charge, this tends toward distance: people stop telling you things, or resentment builds behind an unspoken truth. If you speak plainly and without punishing, a fair understanding is still likely.
outcome.zh: 如果一直让这股锋利做主，事情往往会走向疏远：别人不再跟你说实话，或怨气在一句没说出口的真话后面越积越多。若能把话讲明又不带惩罚，公道的共识仍然很有希望。

advice.en: Be as fair to yourself as you would be to someone else, and as fair to them as the evidence allows. Lower the guard a little, keep the standards, and say the difficult thing without contempt.
advice.zh: 对自己要像对别人一样公道，对别人则要做到证据允许的那份公道。把戒备放低一点，标准照旧，难说的话说出来，但别带着轻蔑。

hidden.en: Ask what the sharpness is protecting. An old bruise may be writing your conclusions, or a truth you swallowed to keep the peace may be turning into resentment out of sight.
hidden.zh: 问一问这份尖锐在护着什么。也许是一道旧伤在替你下结论，也可能是一句为了息事宁人咽下去的真话，正在看不见的地方变成怨气。

self.en: You come to this guarded, expecting to be let down, with sarcasm ready as a shield. You may also be turning that critical eye on yourself, judging your own feelings more severely than you would anyone else's.
self.zh: 你带着戒备而来，预料自己会失望，随时准备拿讽刺当盾牌。你也可能把那双挑剔的眼睛转向了自己，对自己情绪的审判比对任何人都严。

other.en: They may come across as cold, critical, or quick to cut off contact. They appear to be defending themselves, so treat harsh words as a sign of guardedness before taking them as a verdict on you.
other.zh: 对方可能显得冷淡、挑剔，或动不动就切断联系。他们看起来是在自我防卫，所以先把那些重话当作戒备的表现，别急着当成对你的定论。

external.en: The atmosphere is critical and unforgiving. Remarks carry an edge, people are quick to judge and slow to explain, and honest things are either said harshly or left unsaid.
external.zh: 周围的气氛挑剔而不留情面。话里带刺，人们评判得快、解释得慢，实话要么被说得很重，要么干脆没人说。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to lower your guard and still be safe, yet fear that softening will invite the same hurt again. You want to say what you really think and dread both the silence and the quarrel that might follow.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着放下戒备之后依然安全，又怕心一软，同样的伤害就会再来一遍。你想说出真实的想法，却既怕随之而来的沉默，也怕随之而来的争吵。

general.en: Check whether your edge is protecting clarity or defending an old bruise. Speak plainly without punishing.
general.zh: 先确认自己的锋芒是在守护清晰，还是在护着一道旧伤。把事实与底线说清楚即可，不必带着惩罚或尖刻语气。

love.en: In love, reversed Queen of Swords cautions against icy withdrawal, keeping score, or testing a partner instead of stating what hurt.
love.zh: 在感情中，宝剑王后逆位提醒警惕冷战疏离、暗自记账，或用带刺的试探反复考验伴侣，却始终不肯坦白真正令你受伤的痛点。

career.en: At work, beware hyper-critical feedback that shuts teammates down, or letting personal bias distort an evaluation. Return to concrete evidence.
career.zh: 在职场上，避免过度挑剔或居高临下的措辞把协作者推远，也警惕个人成见左右评审判断，重新回到客观可验证的事实依据上。

health.en: Notice where harsh self-talk or mental rumination is adding tension; give your nervous system space to decompress.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，留意严苛的自我批判、过度思虑与紧绷的戒备感是否在持续消耗睡眠与精力，给神经系统留出真正的缓冲空间。

spirituality.en: Release the belief that staying guarded equals staying wise; open perception sees further than suspicion.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，放下必须时刻戒备才算清醒的执念；敞开、沉静而温和的洞察力，往往比处处设防的猜疑看得更透彻、更长远。

archetypeEssence.en: Sovereign, principled intellect—delivering impartial judgment and strategic command unshaken by noise.
archetypeEssence.zh: 沉稳笃定的原则权威——不为噪音与私心所动，以公正理智立定大局。

en: Composed King seated squarely facing forward upon a tall carved stone throne
One straight upright sword held firmly in his right hand tilted slightly at calm attention
Deep blue tunic and royal slate-violet mantle denoting intellectual discipline and ethics
Butterflies and crescent moons carved cleanly into the high throne back
Still towering clouds, twin soaring birds, and upright cypresses framing a lucid horizon
zh: 正面端坐于高背雕花石座、神情沉静威严的国王
右手沉稳竖握、微斜戒备的一柄雪亮直剑
象征严谨理智与法度原则的深蓝内袍与灰紫披风
高耸石座靠背上精致雕刻的蝶翼与新月浮雕
高空沉静云层、双飞高鸟与挺立柏树映出的开阔视野

en: Commanding Belle Epoque King seated squarely front-facing on a monumental carved pale-limestone throne above serene high-altitude twilight clouds
Exactly one broad, straight, gleaming frost-silver and antique-gold sword held upright at a subtle poised tilt in his right hand
Sculptural midnight-cobalt tunic, draped storm-slate and deep-plum velvet mantle, and architectural antique-gold circlet crown
Intricate Art Nouveau butterflies and silver crescent moons etched into the tall rectangular throne back, flanked by two dark upright cypresses
Two distant birds gliding smoothly across crisp moonlit silver air above the King's steady, impartial gaze
zh: 端坐于高空静云之上雕花浅石王座、正面平视前方的威严美好年代国王
右手稳稳握持、笔直微倾的一柄霜银古金阔刃直剑
深钴蓝修身礼袍、风暴灰与暗紫丝绒披风以及规整古金冠冕
高背方正石座上精雕的新艺术蝶纹与银月浮雕，两侧挺立两株暗色柏树
清朗月色高空中振翅滑翔的两只远景飞鸟，呼应国王沉稳公正的凝视

core.en: King of Swords embodies mature analytical authority: apply fair standards consistently, think three moves ahead, and decide from clear evidence and ethics rather than impulse or favoritism.
core.zh: 宝剑国王体现成熟沉稳的理智权威：始终如一地执行公正标准、提前想清三步后的格局，依据事实与原则拍板，而不被情绪或私情牵着走。

message.en: Step into executive clarity—set objective criteria, seek expert counsel if needed, and make the fair call cleanly.
message.zh: 拿出一锤定音的清明格局——立定客观标准，必要时请教顶尖专业人士，干脆利落地作出公正裁决。

foundation.en: Strict standards, seasoned expertise, or a clear framework of rules established the structure you are operating inside.
foundation.zh: 严谨的规则意识、长期沉淀的专业口碑或明确的制度框架，搭起了如今运行的基础。

present.en: This situation calls for cool headship: rise above emotional noise, examine the whole system, and hold everyone—including yourself—to the same standard.
present.zh: 当下需要能镇住场面的冷静统领：跳出情绪噪音，从全局审视机制，对包括自己在内的所有人执行同一把尺子。

challenge.en: Austere logic may be leaving out human warmth, or turning reasonable standards into a wall nobody feels able to approach.
challenge.zh: 一丝不苟的理性可能遗漏了人情温度，或把原本合理的标准垒成了一堵让人不敢靠近的高墙。

resource.en: Your leverage lies in unshakable reasoning and credibility—whether your own mastery or a seasoned advisor, lawyer, architect, or mentor in your corner.
resource.zh: 你手里最硬的倚仗是站得住脚的逻辑与公信力——既可以是你自身的专业积淀，也可以是身边那位值得信赖的资深专家、法务或导师。

action.en: Define the governing principle in writing, review the key facts systematically, and deliver a firm, transparent decision with zero ambiguity.
action.zh: 把核心原则白纸黑字立清，系统核查全部关键事实，随后给出明确透明、毫无含糊的最终拍板。

outcome.en: If fair standards keep governing, order, sound governance, and lasting respect are likely to follow—a clean ruling or disciplined strategy that tends to hold steady under scrutiny.
outcome.zh: 只要公正的标准继续主导，秩序、稳健的治理与长久的敬重很可能随之而来——一份干净的裁定或有章法的战略，往往经得起检验。

advice.en: Lead with ethics as well as intellect—the sharpest authority earns trust because its rules protect fairness, not ego.
advice.zh: 把道义与理智一同握在手里——最高级的权威之所以令人信服，是因为它的规则守护公正，而非只服务于面子。

hidden.en: Find out which rule or authority is actually deciding this. A standard, a contract term, or a person with the final say may be operating in the background; ask too whether reasoning alone is leaving out something that matters.
hidden.zh: 弄清真正在决定这件事的是哪条规则或哪位权威。一项标准、一条合同条款或一个有最终决定权的人，也许正在幕后起作用；还要问一问，单靠讲道理是否漏掉了某样要紧的东西。

self.en: You approach this as the one responsible for a fair decision. You think before you speak, hold yourself to your own rules, and present a calm authority that others rely on, even when it keeps your feelings out of view.
self.zh: 你是以“要做出公正决定的那个人”的身份来面对这件事的。你先想后说，用自己定的规矩要求自己，展现出让别人倚靠的沉稳权威，哪怕这会把你自己的感受挡在别人看不见的地方。

other.en: The other party appears measured, well informed, and firm about standards. They may hold authority here or act as though they do, and they are likely to judge by evidence and consistency more than by appeals to feeling.
other.zh: 对方显得从容、懂行，对标准毫不松口。他们可能在这件事上握有权威，或表现得如此，也多半会按证据和前后是否一致来评判，而不看感情上的恳求。

external.en: Formal structures govern this: rules, contracts, professional standards, or the ruling of someone in authority. The process is orderly and impartial, and it tends to weigh a documented case above a personal one.
external.zh: 这件事由正式的框架管着：规章、合同、专业标准，或某位权威的裁定。流程有序而不偏不倚，有据可查的陈述往往比个人的说法更有分量。

hopes_fears.en: You hope for a fair ruling based on the facts, yet fear being judged by a standard you cannot meet. You want to be the one who decides wisely and worry about carrying that responsibility alone.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着一个以事实为依据的公正裁决，又怕被一把自己够不着的尺子衡量。你想成为那个做出明智决定的人，却担心这份责任要一个人扛。

general.en: Disciplined reasoning, ethical consistency, and strategic altitude resolve this cleanly. Let verified principles govern the outcome.
general.zh: 严谨思辨、表里如一的原则与全局高度能干净解开此局。让经得起验证的准则主导最终走向。

love.en: In love, King of Swords values integrity, reliability, and clear commitments over theatrical promises. Show care through fairness and kept words, while remembering to let warmth show too.
love.zh: 在感情中，宝剑国王看重守信、坦荡与清晰承诺，远胜华丽誓言。用公平担当与说到做到表达爱意，同时也别忘了留出柔软温度。

career.en: At work, this is executive leadership, sound architecture, legal or financial rigor, and impartial governance. Rely on transparent metrics and seasoned expertise.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，他代表高阶统筹、扎实架构、法务与风控严谨以及公正决策。依靠透明标准与专业深度稳步推进。

health.en: For wellbeing, take an informed, structured approach—consult qualified specialists when needed and follow a clear, evidence-backed routine steadily.
health.zh: 在身心管理上，适合采取理性而系统的方法——必要时请教专业人士，并稳步执行有据可依的规律方案。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, this is sovereignty of mind: observing passions without being swept away, aligning thought, speech, and action in quiet integrity.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，宝剑国王代表心智的清明主权：如实觉察情绪起伏却不被裹挟，让所思、所言与所行在静定诚实中合而为一。

core.en: King of Swords reversed warns of distorted authority—either weaponizing sharp logic to dominate and control, or abdicating judgment into icy detachment and drift.
core.zh: 宝剑国王逆位警示权威失衡——要么把精明逻辑当成压迫与操控他人的工具，要么陷入冷漠抽离，在需要拍板时放弃担当。

blocked.en: Withholding a needed decision out of detachment or fear of being accountable for the ruling.
blocked.zh: 因过度抽离或不想替后果担责，迟迟不肯作出该由你下的决断。

excess.en: Rigid authoritarianism, intellectual arrogance, or twisting technicalities to win at others' expense.
excess.zh: 居高临下的强硬专断、智力傲慢，或钻规则空子压制别人。

internalized.en: Policing your own feelings with a cold internal magistrate that leaves zero room for vulnerability.
internalized.zh: 在心里安了一位冷冰冰的法官时刻审查自己的情绪，绝不允许一丝脆弱露面。

release.en: Stepping down from rigid control and letting fair dialogue replace unilateral decrees.
release.zh: 从僵硬控制中退一步，用平等透明的讨论取代独断发令。

message.en: Ask who the argument is serving. Reasoning that exists to win or to control has stopped being fair, and declining to decide is a decision too, with consequences of its own.
message.zh: 问一问这番道理是在为谁服务。只为了赢或为了掌控而讲的理，已经谈不上公正；而拒绝做决定本身也是一种决定，同样有它的后果。

foundation.en: Authority was misused or left vacant earlier on. Rules were applied harshly or bent for someone's benefit, or a decision that needed making was avoided, and trust in the process suffered.
foundation.zh: 先前，权威要么被滥用，要么缺了位。规则被执行得过于严苛，或为了某人的好处被扭曲，再不然就是一个该做的决定被躲了过去，大家对这套程序的信任也因此受损。

present.en: Judgment is off balance at the moment. Logic is being used to overrule people when it should be solving the problem, or nobody is taking responsibility for a decision that is drifting.
present.zh: 此刻的判断失了平衡。逻辑本该用来解决问题，却被拿来压人；或者一个正在漂着的决定，没有人肯出来负责。

challenge.en: Bias may be hiding behind cold logic here, or a lack of clear leadership may be letting bad structure slide unchecked.
challenge.zh: 也许有人正拿冷静逻辑包装偏见，也可能是缺少明确的主心骨，任由糟糕的规则与架构无人过问地滑下去。

resource.en: The knowledge and the capacity to reason are still present, and they can be put back in the service of fairness. A willingness to open the decision to discussion would restore much of the lost trust.
resource.zh: 学识和讲理的能力都还在，可以重新拿来为公道服务。只要愿意把这个决定摊开来讨论，失去的信任就能挽回一大半。

action.en: Audit the logic for hidden self-interest, invite one honest check on your blind spots, and enforce fairness without bullying.
action.zh: 先检查推论背后有没有夹带私心，主动听取一位敢讲真话者的校验，在不压人的前提下守住公道。

outcome.en: Resentment or stalled direction builds if control replaces fairness; resetting transparency restores respect quickly.
outcome.zh: 若继续拿控制替代公正，只会积攒抵触或让方向失焦；重新立起透明原则，信任很快便能修复。

advice.en: Check your motives before citing the rulebook—real authority serves the truth rather than winning compliance.
advice.zh: 搬出规则之前先检视自己的动机——真正的权威服务于事实，而不是用来逼人顺从。

hidden.en: Look for an interest behind the reasoning. A well-constructed argument may be covering a personal stake, and a fear of being held accountable may be presenting itself as neutrality.
hidden.zh: 找一找这番道理背后有没有利益。一套严丝合缝的论证，也许盖着一份私人的得失；而害怕担责的心理，也可能正以“保持中立”的面目出现。

self.en: You show up either controlling, certain that your logic settles the matter, or detached and unwilling to rule. Inwardly you may be judging your own feelings so strictly that none of them gets a hearing.
self.zh: 你在这里要么强势掌控，认定自己的逻辑足以定论，要么冷眼抽离，不肯拍板。在心里，你可能对自己的感受审得太严，以至于哪一种都不许开口。

other.en: They may be using rules, technicalities, or a superior tone to keep the upper hand, or withholding a decision that is theirs to make. Judge their fairness by what they do, since their argument may sound better than it is.
other.zh: 对方可能在用规则、技术细节或高人一等的口气来占上风，也可能把一个该由他们做的决定压着不给。看他们是否公道要看做法，因为他们的道理听起来可能比实际更漂亮。

external.en: The system around you is either heavy-handed or leaderless. Rules are enforced rigidly and to someone's advantage, or nobody in charge is deciding anything, so do not assume the process will be fair unprompted.
external.zh: 你周围的体系不是手太重，就是没人做主。规则被僵硬地执行，而且偏向某一方，要么就是管事的人什么都不定，所以别指望这套程序会自动公正。

hopes_fears.en: Your hope is to keep control by being right; your fear is what happens if someone questions your reasoning. You may also wish someone else would make the call, and dread being blamed for the result.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望靠“我是对的”来稳住局面，害怕的是有人质疑你的推理之后会发生什么。你也可能盼着由别人来拍板，同时担心结果出了问题要自己背责任。

general.en: Watch for manipulative rhetoric, rigid control, or detached indecision. Anchor back in transparent facts and humble accountability.
general.zh: 警惕精致却带私心的说辞、僵化控制或冷眼旁观式的推诿。重新锚定在透明事实与坦荡担当上。

love.en: In love, reversed King of Swords warns against intellectualizing away hurt feelings, lecturing a partner, or using cold silence to keep the upper hand.
love.zh: 在感情中，宝剑国王逆位提醒警惕拿讲道理掩盖情感冷漠、居高临下说教，或用冰冷沉默维持关系里的控制权。

career.en: At work, look out for micromanagement, weaponized policy, biased reviews, or leadership ducking tough calls. Keep every commitment documented and objective.
career.zh: 在职场上，留意过度管控、拿制度卡人、夹带私心的评审，或管理者回避关键拍板。把关键承诺落于客观记录。

health.en: Rigid self-policing or ignoring bodily signals because they do not fit your schedule backfires; temper discipline with real responsiveness.
health.zh: 过度刻板的自律，或因“不在计划内”而无视身体疲惫信号，终究适得其反；给克制配上真诚倾听身体的弹性。

spirituality.en: Intellect without compassion turns brittle; soften the urge to judge everything from a high perch and reconnect with lived humility.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，失去悲悯的理智终将变得干硬脆弱；从居高临下的评判席上走下来，重新连接踏实谦逊的日常。
